items.title: feat(login): support custom HTTP headers per login
items.body:
Allow a login to carry extra HTTP headers that are sent with every request to its server. This makes tea usable with forges behind an authenticating proxy such as Cloudflare Access, which needs CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret service-token headers on each request.

Fixes #990 

## Changes

- Add `headers` to the login config and `Login.BuildTransport()`, which wraps tea's standard transport (timeouts, User-Agent, insecure TLS) with the login's headers. Use it for the SDK client, the raw API client and OAuth token refresh.
- Pass the headers through the OAuth browser flow (token exchange and re-authentication).
- Add a repeatable `--header`/`-H key:value` flag to `tea login add`, so the initial validation request, basic-auth token creation and the `--oauth` flow can reach a server behind the proxy.
- Move `key:value` header parsing into `httputil.ParseHeaders` and reuse it for `tea api --header`.

Headers already set on a request are never overridden. Git operations over HTTPS do not use these transports; use git's `http.extraHeader` for those.

## Testing

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...`
- New unit tests for `ParseHeaders` and `WithHeaders`
- Manual: `tea login add -H ...` against a local server that rejects requests without the CF headers

items.title: WIP: feat(pulls): add global pull request listing and review
items.body:
Add a global PR scope that searches pull requests across all readable
repositories on the selected Gitea instance without requiring local Git
discovery. Support repository owner/name fields, efficient
issue-search-backed rendering, optional detail loading, CI status
lookup, pagination, and graceful handling of inaccessible repositories.

Extend interactive review to select an open PR globally, including
pagination and selection of the target repository. Guard global-only
flags and invalid combinations, update CLI documentation and examples,
and add coverage for global listing, review selection, degraded results,
validation, and repository-aware CI output.

Fixes: https://gitea.com/gitea/tea/issues/1116

items.title: feat: Add tea deploy-tokens command for repository deploy token management
items.body:
This PR adds support for deploy tokens (HTTPS deploy keys) to the tea CLI, following up on the SDK changes in gitea/go-sdk#846.

Deploy tokens are an alternative to SSH deploy keys - they are HTTPS-based tokens that provide the same functionality but work over HTTPS instead of SSH.

Changes:
- Add `tea deploy-tokens` command with `list`, `create`, `delete` subcommands
- Add print helpers for deploy token display (token shown only at creation time)
- Add unit tests for all commands

Relates to gitea/go-sdk#846
